name: Angostura Recreation Area (Cheyenne Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 2,900 m half-width (whole west shore), 480 m and 200 m half-width frames over the Cheyenne loop and a 130 m half-width frame (0.29 m/px) over 17E/18E, every Go Outdoors SD facID=3 loop 2 (Cheyenne) unit point plotted; all frames rendered; plus the engine's own site photos of 17E and 18E. Main loop 1E-14E: pads in a dense pine stand more than 300 m from Angostura Reservoir. 17E (the nearest RV site) ~93 m to the cove to its south and ~127 m to the west shore, through clumps of pines; 18E farther. Engine photos of 17E and 18E show a grassy berm and pines and no water. Only tent-only sites 15 and 16 sit on the open point by the water (what the first evidence line described). Re-measured for Cheyenne alone after Cascade, Hat Creek and Horsehead were split out: no RV site has the water in sight -> not waterfront (was lakeview at park level).
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=3 ('Angostura Recreation Area'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, active units of loop 2 (Cheyenne): 16 web-bookable electric RV sites 1E-14E, 17E, 18E, every one 'Back-In Campsite', 'Amp Service: 20/30/50', MaxEquipLength 35-65 ft (3E's 75 looks like the engine default and was not used), UnitBasePrice $30; tent-only 15, 16, 19-22 ($16); camping cabins C5, C6, C9, C14; V1-V3 'Campground Host' ($37). GFP campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/angostura_campgrounds.pdf (ArcGIS Pro, 2023-05-23): the same numbering, V1-V3 marked host sites, restroom/shower building, vault toilets, water and dump station; overview map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/angostura_overview.pdf: Cheyenne just inside the north entrance off US-385. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-in pads at the unit points on a loop off the park road. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 35 ft, 7E/8E). Cascade (2.33 km RV-site centroid to centroid) and Hat Creek + Horsehead (4.81 km) split out 2026-11-22. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Angostura Recreation Area's Cheyenne campground, just inside the north entrance off US-385/18, 10 mi SE of Hot Springs, nearest the marina, the Angostura Resort concession (restaurant, lodges) and the day-use beaches. The loop sits in pines back from the shore. Cascade, and Hat Creek with Horsehead, farther down the west shore are separate entries. --Claude

sites.note: Plus tent-only sites 15, 16 and 19-22 and camping cabins C5, C6, C9 and C14.

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

fees.note: GFP publishes this park's own rate: electric $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the figure); the $16 non-electric sites are tent-only. Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.

_reasons: Angostura's four campgrounds sit along 5 km of the west shore, each on its own road off the park road. Cascade (engine loop 1, 63 RV sites) is 2.33 km from Cheyenne and 2.15 km from Hat Creek RV-site centroid to centroid: split out. Hat Creek (loop 4, 23) and Horsehead (loop 5, 51) are only 720 m apart (nearest sites 424 m) at the south entrance, so they stay together as one new entry, 2.59 km from Cascade. The stored pin was 61 m from Cheyenne's centroid, so the id stays on Cheyenne (loop 2, 16 RV sites). Kept entry re-cut to Cheyenne: name, pin to the RV-site centroid, waterfront lakeview -> not waterfront (re-measured), both evidence fields, note, hookups, sites (16, 65 ft, no pull-thrus), facilities, season note, booking and fee provenance. trips.campground_references(5714) == [].
